mapper.select: SELECT FROM notice WHERE sports_meeting_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM notice WHERE sports_meeting_id = #{sportsMeetingId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, file_url, file_name, sports_meeting_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{sportsMeetingId})
